heading, No contract lock in, level 2
You don't need another vendor tying you into a long contract and then failing to deliver on their promises. You can cancel Spill anytime with 30 days notice.
heading, People get real, human support, level 2
No AI counsellors here. We offer sessions with a counsellor for staff who are struggling with their mental health.
end of heading, Always confidential, level 2
